properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This is the wallet's keystore encryption: the BIP39 mnemonic (full wallet seed) is encrypted at rest under an Android Keystore AES-256-GCM key with StrongBox/TEE preference and optional biometric gating (AuthenticationLevel STRONGBOX_*/TEE_*). Quantum-resistant symmetric AEAD — the good part of this app's posture. Sites 49-52,65-66 are the AES-GCM TLS suites in the currently-unwired INFURA_CIPHER_SUITES list.
